objects.taxonomy_description: Composite flower with a central yellow disc surrounded by a single whorl of white ray petals (florets). The flower head measures 2-5 cm in diameter with 13-34 elongated white petals radiating outward from the bright yellow center. The petals are narrow, slightly pointed, and arranged in a flat, circular pattern. The flower is supported by a slender green stem with small alternate leaves. The center disc has a bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.

Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with cloven hooves.

objects.taxonomy_description: An inanimate manufactured object designed for play, distinguished from living organisms by its artificial construction and lack of biological features.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Finish: Visible seams, mold lines, or uniform artificial coloring indicate industrial manufacturing processes instead of natural growth patterns.
